 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Claimants are before this Court assailing the judgment and award dated 31.07.2017 passed by in LACA No.116/2017 by the III Additional District Judge, Kalaburagi (for short 'Appellate Court')
enhancing compensation to Rs.1,10,920/- per acre for dry land, modifying the judgment and award dated 13.06.2001 passed in LAC No.505/1999 by the Addl. Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.) Kalaburagi (for short 'Reference Court').
The Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation of Rs.8,000/- per acre for dry land; in the NC: 2024:KHC-K:3834 reference sought before the Reference Court, the compensation was enhanced to Rs.30,000/- per acre for the dry land and in the appeal preferred by the claimant before the Appellate Court compensation of 1,10,920/- has been awarded for the dry land.
opennyai_summary.final__facts:
7. Claimants' land was acquired under preliminary notification dated 13.01.1994 for the purpose of construction of Bhunyar Minor Irrigation Project.
The Land Acquisition Officer assessed market value at Rs.8,000/- per acre for dry land.
The Reference Court awarded compensation of Rs.30,000/- per acre.
Aggrieved by the compensation of the reference Court, the claimants preferred NC: 2024:KHC-K:3834 appeal before the Appellate Court.
The appellate Court awarded compensation of Rs.1,10,920/- per acre for dry land.
The notification, the purpose for acquisition and the potentiality of the lands of the claimant is as exemplar to LACA No.236/2016.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Considering the market value determined by the Appellate Court in LACA No.236/2016 and the decision of the Co-Ordinate Bench of this NC:
2024:KHC-K:3834 Court being squarely applicable to the facts of the present case, as the notification is dated 13.01.1994, de-escalation needs to be set into force and if de-escalation is taken at 5%, the market value that the claimants would be entitled is at the rate of Rs.1,77,910/- per acre with all statutory benefits and interest thereon as per the law.
Accordingly, this Court pass the following:
ORDER i. The miscellaneous second appeal is hereby allowed in part;
ii.
The claimants are entitled to compensation of Rs.1,77,910/- per acre with all statutory benefits and interest thereon, with cost;
